# Vault Member System

> The Vault Member Portal is VaultSpark's cross-game identity and progress layer — one account across every VaultSpark title.

## What it is
Vault Member is the cross-game identity and progress layer for VaultSpark Studios. Members earn experience points (XP) from gameplay and studio activity, advance through nine Vault Ranks (Recruit → Warden), complete challenges, unlock perks, and access early game builds. Two tiers exist: the free Vault Member tier and VaultSparked (the premium tier), which adds exclusive Discord roles, priority support, and first-wave access to new releases. Registration is free with no credit card required.

## Current focus
Live and active — members can register, earn XP, advance ranks, and track progress across VaultSpark games and community activities.

## Next milestone
Continued XP system expansion and Obelisk identity integration (unified account across every VaultSpark surface).
